text: I hope they work they seemed rather stiff and stinky, in the washing machine now. They really smell coming out of the package and felt very just for the thread count alone. They're in the washer now but I've never had a thread count this High feel so low-grade cotton out of the pack but we shall see because I know they put sizing on the fabric and I can use them regardless but I was just really disappointed since I u s e h i g h thread bed sheets a general rule and these did not feel like any of them usually do out of the package. We will see if the smell goes away, if they're soft after the first laundering and what the wrinkle factor is. Unless the negative review is pulled like so many yet again I will edit when I change my sheets later today.
